validity.researcher_notes: Pipeline is real and well-documented: Pipeline News Oct 2018 announces the Permian Global Access Pipeline by Tellurian from Pecos County TX (Waha area) to Gillis LA with 2,000 MMcf/d capacity. EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook confirms status progression (Announced 2018 -> Cancelled 2020-12-03). The route geometry (610 mi calculated) corroborates the 625 mi length. However, the sheet records StartYear1=2022, which is contradictory: the project was withdrawn/cancelled in December 2020 (per EIA and Reuters). A cancelled project never enters operation, so StartYear1 should be blank or removed. This appears to be a copy-paste residue from an earlier in-service target or an error in the GEM database.
